name: jira-queue-monitor
description: Monitor de fila N1 do Jira com resumo rapido, tempo sem resposta e notificacoes

scripts.build: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const fs=require('fs'); const sha=execSync('git rev-parse HEAD').toString().trim(); fs.writeFileSync('version.txt', sha); console.log('Version:', sha);"
